svg.title: The Libero design hierarchy. aegis_pqc is a user block with two children: aegis_keccak, with its round function, and aegis_ntt, with the modular multiplier, twiddle ROM and dual-port RAM.
svg.desc: The Libero design hierarchy. aegis_pqc is a user block with two children: aegis_keccak, with its round function, and aegis_ntt, with the modular multiplier, twiddle ROM and dual-port RAM.

g.text: One block on the APB bus holding both engines.
One round per clock: 24 clocks per permutation.
Modular multiplier, twiddle ROM and RAM; one butterfly per clock.
MSS_WRAPPER and the reference design's peripherals sit beside it.
